The zoom picks the level: 40 / 74 / 100 rows → 17.6 / 9.5 / 7.0 px, L0 / L1 / L2 (§3 L197-198); the zone state is server-told (pending GAP-18, L288-289). D6 (L156): inside out at one edge, the level box last (B). D3 (L153), D4 (L154); QA R4, Q8 (L125); OQ-5 open (L924).

At L2 it adds 'footprint at low detail' (§8.2 L749); a newly formed stack is announced, forming-cell updates never (L749-750).

copy_gaps: '×3 sell tested' (C, L2) fills §4.4's label with the 13:15 stack's side; no spec line writes a sell label (§18 L956: '×N buy | sell').
§4.4 gives the chart label no weight or grey per zone state (SCR-056's semibold / regular is §7.1 L678): every label is ink; the bracket's weight and the word carry the state.

Where the full label sits is not stated (L292-293): drawn at the bracket's top end in place of the short label, on the raised fill (kit); without a free margin its ≈ 230 px would cover the next bar's cells.
The bracket's end ticks are '2 px … toward it' (L288) with no thickness: drawn as thick as the bracket (kit).
At L1 the right-aligned delta (≈ 48 px in the 10 px cell type) nearly fills the 50.5 px half the outline covers; §4.4 does not say the number sits inside it (E18-K01 measures the floors).

REVIEW QUESTION (spec author; E18-K01, E18-D03): at L1's 9.5 px rows (§3 L197) the 1.5 px outline, 1 px inside the side-cell (§4.5 L303), leaves 4.5 px inside, under the 10 px digits (about 7 px tall): its top and bottom strokes cross the delta's digits (the offline preview shows it). §4.4 L284-285 keeps the outline at L1; the spec does not say how the digits clear it.

REVIEW QUESTION (spec author; E18-K01): in `delta` at its 40.2 px floor (§4.2 L263-264; §3 L199) the half the outline covers is 20.1 px, and a three-digit delta ('▲ +167', 36 px at 6.0 px a glyph) runs 1.2-37.2 px into the cell: the half outline's left stroke crosses its digits (D). §4.4 L284-285 outlines the half in the one-number modes; the spec does not say how the number clears it.
At 7.0 px rows (L2) the 10 px label is taller than the row it sits on (L290-291); E18-K01 checks it reads.

SCR-056's worked tested and broken rows (§7 L665-666: 13:20 ×4 sell 64,031.0–64,034.9 tested; 13:05 ×5 buy 63,988.0–63,992.9 broken) have no cells, and the tested one lies above the 40-row window (63,974.0–64,013.0), so C uses the generator's 13:15 ×3 sell 64,001.0–64,003.9 at 975 %, tested: boards 19, 13-15 and 49 show different tested stacks. For E25-D02 (#668) and E18-D05 (#499): one worked tested stack with cells.
seed '20260928' (the bench CLI default) and cellsPerBar 40: §3 L172 names the generator but no seed; its default is 25 cells per bar

L1 crops: the outline's strokes cross the 10 px digits at 9.5 px rows, and the ▲ of a right-aligned delta meets the right-half outline's left edge (≈ 1.5 px apart by the kit's metrics); check how both read at scale 1 (Copy gaps: REVIEW QUESTION).
A: the 3 / 2 / 1 px bracket weights stay distinct at scale 1 (no half-pixel blur) across the three columns.
B: the level box reads back with strokeAlignment 'center' (set locally); the ring sits between 64,011.0's outline and its neighbours'; all three outlines read with the ring on.
B: the cursor column is two 2 × 88 px edges (x 0 and 117) with no top or bottom edge; the level box's sides (x −1 to 1, 118 to 120) meet them, and the 3 px bracket (x 114-117) stays clear.
C L2: the label pill overhangs the crop's top row by about 4.5 px (the crop is not clipped); check it clears the bracket's top tick in the left lane.
D: the half outline's left stroke (column x 32.1-33.6) crosses the '1' of '▲ +146', '▲ +167' and '▲ +138'; check how the digits read at scale 1 (Copy gaps: REVIEW QUESTION).
The notes card wraps its text at 368 px like the annotation column; its top aligns with the frame's.
cell digits: auto-width texts at a computed x (JetBrains Mono 0.6 em): check each side's digits share a right edge and the × column lines up; ▲ / ▼ must come from JetBrains Mono
rename frame 'SCR-030∕fp-imbalance' to 'SCR-030/fp-imbalance' after the board's last section (Penpot shows 'SCR-030 / fp-imbalance')
root: after the first section the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name
deviations: The frame is a sheet of 1:1 crops of the SCR-030 plot, not one chart: a 1280 × 800 pane holds one zoom level and §0 L61's row asks for L0, L1, L2 and three zone states at once. The chrome (toolbar, status row, strip row, legend, gutters, time strip) is board 01's; each crop is the plot at §3's compact geometry with its level's row height (§3 L179-180, L197-198). B's cursor column is drawn as its two 2 px edges (x 0 and 117): E06-D03 D10's column runs the pane's full height and the crop cuts it, so it has no top or bottom edge here (the kit's closed box read as a ring around the five levels).

B's level box is a 2 px ring centred on the level's edges (set locally; the kit's _marks() draws it inner): its band (crop y 34.2-36.2 and 51.8-53.8) fills the gap between 64,011.0's outline (36.2-51.8, 1 px inside the side-cell, §4.5 L303) and its neighbours' (ending 34.2, starting 53.8), so the level box comes last at one edge and covers no outline (D6 L156). Drawn inner, it covered 1.0 px of each 1.5 px horizontal stroke.

Only the imbalance marks are drawn (outline, bracket, label): SCR-032's defaults also draw the POC rail, VA ticks, forming cap and unfinished-auction ledge (§6.2 L520-522), boards 20 and 21's (§0 L62-63); bar 13:35 is drawn without its cap, so the three zone states read on one stack.

A's, B's and D's crops give the newest bar a free margin (88 px; 244 px for B's full label; 48 px for D's '×3 buy') so §4.4 L290's placement shows; at board 01's ten bars it is 18 px (1,208 − 10 × 119: §3 L181, L185), under '×3 buy' (≈ 36 px), so there the label waits for hover, focus or selection.

D is drawn here: §4.4, board 19's section, is where the one-number modes' half outline is ruled (L284-285; D5 L155), and neither board 16's row (§0 L58) nor §4.2 carries outlines. D is A's column in `delta` at L0 (pitch 58.2 px with the 40.2 px floor, §3 L199-201), active, with the right half outlined on 64,010.0-64,012.0 and '×3 buy' in its free margin.

Edge levels are not compared (the kit's imbalances(edges='skip') and its 'edges' note, here with the carry): `24` §4.2's zero-denominator rule (treat_as_min, the default) treats a missing neighbour outside the bar as zero volume, so 13:35's high 64,013.0 (bid 3 over no ask: 3 / 0.001 = 3,000 ≥ 3.0) would flag sell, outlining its bid side-cell at L0 and its left half at L1 and in D.
